subject: Backend Engineering Intern: referral request
body:
I noticed Ledgerline is looking to improve its CI pipeline for the Backend Engineering Intern role. As a third-year CS student who enjoys building backend services, I recently built a 90-question evaluation suite run in CI that blocks merges which reduce accuracy, and exposed the parser as a REST API.

Would you be open to referring me for the position, or pointing me to the right person? My resume is attached.
personalization_source: Containerise services with Docker and help improve our CI pipeline.
